headline: Votes on new retirement board members, superannuation and transfer requests, and a refund/rollover request.
summary: The board will review financial reports, vote on light duty and creditable service, new members, superannuation, transfers, and a refund/rollover request. It will also discuss PERAC correspondence, deaths of members, and meet in executive session on office security and disability retirements.
